Type: desk
Name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Solid Pine Writing Desk, 53.25"W, Antique Espresso
Colors: Brown
Materials: Wood
53.25"W x 22.6"D x 29.75"H Solid pine construction with metal hardware This sturdy piece has two large drawers perfect for storage and a large working surface, making this the ideal work-at-home desk. The antique espresso finish is complemented by metal hardware and style details that give this writing desk a midcentury look. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
